dict.string: Lifelog can attach photos and media you choose to your journal and daily records.
Lifelog can save exported media or files you choose.
Lifelog can capture photos and videos you choose to add to your journal and daily records.
Lifelog uses the microphone when you choose to record audio or video for your journal and daily records.

Lifelog transcribes your finished voice recording after you stop recording. Recognition runs on this device when the language supports on-device transcription; Lifelog does not upload the audio to a speech service.

Lifelog uses your location, when you allow it, to record where you spend time, show your live position on the map, and save precise places or pins. Location history stays on this device in your encrypted archive.

With Always access, Lifelog can automatically note places you visit and show them on your private map, even when the app is not open. No continuous background GPS is used; location history stays on this device in your encrypted archive and is never uploaded by Lifelog.

Lifelog can read your sleep and step data from Apple Health, if you choose, to track your daily health metrics in the app. This access is read-only and data stays on your device.
Lifelog does not write health data to Apple Health.
